14/// A Pantone Matching System (PMS) color name.
15///
16/// The enum covers 1342 coated (`C`) and 1335 uncoated (`U`) spot
17/// colors of the Pantone system - named process colors
18/// (`Pantone Process Blue C`), named mixes (`Pantone Cool Gray 1 U`)
19/// and the numbered colors (`Pantone 485 C`), whose variants carry a
20/// `Pms` prefix since Rust identifiers must not start with a digit.
21/// The suffix letter is a [`PantoneSuffix`].
22///
23/// Names parse case-insensitively via [`FromStr`]; [`Display`] and the
24/// wire format use the canonical `Pantone <name> <suffix>` form.
25///
26/// The stored sRGB values are common approximations of the print
27/// colors, e.g. as published on
28/// [brandible.de](https://www.brandible.de/pantone-farben) (coated)
29/// and in the
30/// [Pantone_finder dataset](https://github.com/picorana/Pantone_finder)
31/// (uncoated) - Pantone colors are defined for print, so the values
32/// are indicative rather than authoritative. The CMYK builds of
33/// [`Self::to_cmyk`] follow the
34/// [Pantone-CMYK-RGB-Hex dataset](https://github.com/adonald/Pantone-CMYK-RGB-Hex).
35/// PANTONE is a trademark of Pantone LLC.
36#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
37#[cfg_attr(feature = "schemars", derive(schemars::JsonSchema))]
38pub enum PantoneNamedColor {

10756        match self.as_str().bytes().last() {
10757            Some(b'U') => PantoneSuffix::Uncoated,
10758            Some(b'M') => PantoneSuffix::Matte,
10759            _ => PantoneSuffix::Coated,
10760        }
10761    }
10762
10763    /// The same ink on the other substrate - `C` becomes `U` and
10764    /// vice versa - if the catalog contains the counterpart.
10765    /// Colors without a coated/uncoated pair (e.g. `M` variants or
10766    /// catalog gaps) yield `None`.
10767    pub fn counterpart(&self) -> Option<Self> {
10768        let name = self.as_str();
10769        let swapped = match name.strip_suffix(" C") {
10770            Some(base) => format!("{base} U"),
10771            None => format!("{} C", name.strip_suffix(" U")?),
10772        };
10773        Self::from_str(&swapped).ok()
10774    }
10775

13459    /// The color as opaque byte components.
13460    pub const fn to_color(&self) -> Color<u8> {
13461        Color::from_rgb_u32(self.packed_rgb())
13462    }
13463
13464    /// The nearest Pantone color to `color` in the sRGB space -
13465    /// squared Euclidean distance over the RGB channels, alpha
13466    /// ignored.
13467    pub fn nearest(color: &Color<u8>) -> Self {
13468        // `ALL` is a non-empty const table, so the minimum always exists.
13469        Self::ALL
13470            .iter()
13471            .min_by_key(|candidate| color.squared_rgb_distance(&candidate.to_color()))
13472            .copied()
13473            .unwrap_or(Self::Pms100C)
13474    }

17266impl FromStr for PantoneNamedColor {
17267    type Err = ParseColorError;
17268
17269    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
17270        Self::ALL
17271            .iter()
17272            .find(|color| s.eq_ignore_ascii_case(color.as_str()))
17273            .copied()
17274            .ok_or_else(|| ParseColorError::UnknownPantoneColor { input: s.into() })
17275    }
17276}
17277
17278impl Display for PantoneNamedColor {
17279    /// Formats the canonical `Pantone <name> <suffix>` name.
17280    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
17281        f.write_str(self.as_str())
17282    }
17283}
17284
17285impl From<PantoneNamedColor> for Color<u8> {
17286    fn from(color: PantoneNamedColor) -> Self {
17287        color.to_color()
17288    }
17289}

17291impl From<PantoneNamedColor> for Color<f64> {

17297impl From<PantoneNamedColor> for Color<f32> {

17299        color.to_color().into()
17300    }
17301}
17302
17303impl From<PantoneNamedColor> for HexColor {

17305        Self::from(color.to_color())
17306    }
17307}

17309/// The wire format is the canonical `Pantone <name> <suffix>` string.
17310impl Serialize for PantoneNamedColor {
17311    fn serialize<S: Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
17312        serializer.serialize_str(self.as_str())
17313    }
17314}
17315
17316/// Deserialization accepts the name case-insensitively.
17317impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for PantoneNamedColor {
17318    fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
17319        String::deserialize(deserializer)?.parse().map_err(serde::de::Error::custom)
17320    }
17321}

17331#[cfg(test)]
17332mod tests {
17333    use super::*;
17334
17335    #[test]
17336    fn all_covers_the_2677_colors() {
17337        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::ALL.len(), 2677);
17338    }
17339
17340    #[test]
17341    fn all_is_sorted_by_name() {
17342        let names: Vec<&str> = PantoneNamedColor::ALL.iter().map(PantoneNamedColor::as_str).collect();
17343        let mut sorted = names.clone();
17344        sorted.sort();
17345        assert_eq!(names, sorted);
17346    }
17347
17348    #[test]
17349    fn from_str_is_case_insensitive() {
17350        assert_eq!("Pantone 485 C".parse::<PantoneNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneNamedColor::Pms485C);
17351        assert_eq!("pantone 485 c".parse::<PantoneNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneNamedColor::Pms485C);
17352        assert_eq!("PANTONE REFLEX BLUE U".parse::<PantoneNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneNamedColor::ReflexBlueU);
17353    }
17354
17355    #[test]
17356    fn display_and_as_str_produce_the_canonical_name() {
17357        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485C.to_string(), "Pantone 485 C");
17358        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485U.as_str(), "Pantone 485 U");
17359        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::ReflexBlueU.as_str(), "Pantone Reflex Blue U");
17360    }
17361
17362    #[test]
17363    fn display_from_str_round_trip_covers_all_colors() {
17364        for color in PantoneNamedColor::ALL {
17365            assert_eq!(color.to_string().parse::<PantoneNamedColor>().unwrap(), *color);
17366        }
17367    }
17368
17369    #[test]
17370    fn to_color_maps_names_to_srgb() {
17371        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485C.to_color(), Color::<u8>::new(0xDA, 0x29, 0x1C));
17372        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485U.to_color(), Color::<u8>::new(0xE4, 0x5D, 0x50));
17373        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::YellowC.to_color(), Color::<u8>::new(0xFE, 0xDD, 0x00));
17374    }
17375
17376    #[test]
17377    fn suffix_resolves_the_name_ending() {
17378        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485C.suffix(), PantoneSuffix::Coated);
17379        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::Pms485U.suffix(), PantoneSuffix::Uncoated);
17380        assert_eq!(PantoneNamedColor::ALL.iter().filter(|color| color.suffix() == PantoneSuffix::Uncoated).count(), 1335);
17381    }
